info.name: Fetch core accounting entries based on filters.

params.name: company_id
params.description: Only return accounting entries that have the specific company ID. Required if partner_id or organization_id is not provided.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Only return accounting entries that belong to the companies associated.  to the given Organization Id. Required if company_id or partner_id is not provided.

params.name: before
params.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after])

params.name: after
params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before])

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key.

params.name: sorting_keys
params.description: The keys to sort the results by
